# Aging Review

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `DETERMINISTIC-MATH` `TIE-CHECKED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `CLIENT-FACING` `NO-AUTO-SEND` `AUDIT-TRAIL`

Walks A/R and A/P aging oldest-first — flags overdue, stale, duplicate, and credit-balance items, then drafts collections notes and a proposed payment run. Cross-foots the aging to the ledger before any of it is believed.

## Why these badges

- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — Bucket totals must sum to the report total and tie to the balance-sheet A/R or A/P balance. Red until tied.
- **`NO-AUTO-SEND`** — Collections notes are drafts. You send them.
- **`READ-ONLY`** — Items needing accounting action are noted for /accruals or /je-review — suggested, never invoked.

- Send a collections note.
- Guess at a dispute or a counterparty relationship.
